name: B10-0123/2024 (S&D) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking the European Commission to fix problems with the EU rules on medical devices and lab tests. It wants faster, more predictable checks by the bodies that approve devices, more of those bodies approved, fairer fees, and extra help for small companies and for devices made for rare conditions or children. It also wants a full review of the rules.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act and review the rules.
- **Who it affects:** Patients, device makers, and the bodies that certify devices.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
